name: Edit Log
author: AirOne-dev
description: Keeps what a message said before it was edited or deleted, and leaves a deleted one in place instead of letting it vanish

descriptions.fr: Garde ce qu’un message disait avant d’être modifié ou supprimé, et laisse un message supprimé à sa place au lieu de le voir disparaître

settings.label: Leave deleted messages on screen
settings.hint: Struck through, where the message was, with a cross to dismiss it.

settings.label: Record deletions as well as edits
settings.hint: Off means only edits are kept, and nothing is left on screen.

settings.label: Entries to keep
settings.hint: The log lives in BetterSlack's settings file, which is read at every launch, so it is capped.
